observations: White truck with orange drilling rig mounted on the chassis.
The rig features a telescopic mast with a large 'H' logo on the side.
The truck cab is dusty and shows signs of heavy use.
The rig is equipped with hoses and a hydraulic pump assembly.
The truck is parked on a dirt lot with other construction equipment visible in the background.
The engine is not running in any of the photos.

claims.evidence: The engine is not running in the photos, so whether it is sound or not is unknown.
The equipment in the photos is a mobile drilling rig.
The machine is shown in a typical outdoor storage or yard setting.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, have a blown head gasket, or be missing a critical component.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and the rig's hydraulic pump operating.

risks.risk: The hydraulic system may leak fluid or fail to hold pressure.
risks.proof: A video showing the rig's boom and drill head moving without leaks.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty hydraulic system

risks.risk: The rig may be missing essential accessories like the drill bit, casing, or pump.
risks.proof: A photo of all included drilling accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running and the rig's hydraulic system in operation.
Photo of the drill bit and all other included accessories.
Photo of the engine block and the underside of the rig to check for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
